name: Talmai
overview: Talmai appears in Scripture as both a son of Anak, associated with the formidable Anakim defeated by Caleb and the tribe of Judah in Hebron, and as the king of Geshur, whose daughter Maacah was the mother of Absalom, David's son. The Anakim Talmai was one of three giants driven out from Hebron, highlighting God's provision for Israel's conquest (Numbers 13:22; Joshua 15:14; Judges 1:10). Meanwhile, Talmai king of Geshur figures in the royal lineage and David's family struggles, as Absalom fled to him after rebellion, demonstrating the intertwining of Israel's political and family dynamics under God's sovereign plan (2 Samuel 3:3; 2 Samuel 13:37; 1 Chronicles 3:2).
